mission.title: Scanning the Enemy
mission.description: Lead the General's newly programmed commandos against the Effectuator's dire lupines.

phase.briefing: Greetings, Warrior. As you know, the General is anxious to improve his force's abilities to combat the Merovingian's Exiles. They will be putting the experience they gained in studying your combat techniques to the test. Our liaison with the General's men has requested that we bring some of their newly programmed troops on a combat run. Proceed to the indicated location and rendezvous with the commando group.

enter.say: I'm picking up commando program signals in there.

objective.text: Lead Myers and Echler out of the area

phase.briefing: The Effectuator's dire lupines have been unusually active of late. We're not sure what's behind it, but it's a good opportunity for an anti-Exile operation. Lead Myers and Echler against the dire lupines at the location marked on your map.

enter.say: Ah, the erratic flicker of dire lupine signals. Be sure you search thoroughly, they're tricksy.

objective.text: Kill all of the dire lupines

done.say: That takes care of that. Let's see if Tyndall has any more tasks for us.
They were no match for us, sir. I'll stay here to complete an analysis of the Exiles.

phase.briefing: Operative, the General has requested that you proceed to his location ASAP. It seems that he has an additional strategy in mind for combating the Merovingian.

enter.say: The General should be in there.

talk.say: Operative, after analyzing the data from these Exiles, my intel group has determined that we can design enhanced weapons capable of breaking down their code defenses. But to do that, we'll need more data. The men in the room you just came through are programmed to record the precise data structures we need. Take them with you on your next foray against the enemy.

objective.text: Lead Craven, De Bonte and Foster out of the area

phase.briefing: Warrior, I know you will do your best to get as much data as you can for the commandos. The enhanced weapons the General has proposed could help us finally crack the Merovingian's organization, and bring Morpheus' killer to justice.

enter.say: I've got a whole screen of signals in there. You could have a heck of a lot of dire lupines on your hands. Let's hope those soldiers of yours can fight as well as they salute.

objective.text: Kill all of the dire lupines

done.say: Okay... Okay, I think that's all of them. Man, I hate those things. I sure hope the commandos relayed some useful data.
If you can keep getting us data like this, sir, we'll have those enhanced weapons ready in no time.
Sir, that was impressive! I'm sure the General will find this data very useful!
Thank you, sir! I'm relaying my data to HQ now.

mission.finish: The General's liaison tells me that they are receiving some very high quality data from your operation, {player}. I knew you'd come through. If the General's engineers can use this data to design enhanced weapons as they claimed, we'll have the Merovingian's Exiles on the run very shortly.
